versions.changelog: 完善独立运行与数据核验边界

Initial release of asset-analysis skill for comprehensive quantitative analysis of stocks and ETFs across A-shares, HK stocks, and US stocks.

- Integrates real EPS accounting, multi-model fair value estimation, full financials analysis, over 20 technical indicators, and macro regime calibration.
- Data authenticity is strictly enforced: only real OHLC, financial, and technical data are allowed; analysis halts if key data is missing.
- Supports scenario-based valuation using at least three mainstream models (PE, PEG, PB-ROE/PS, DCF, etc.).
- Provides standardized markdown output for asset quantitative research reports with core metrics, multi-model price targets, technical analysis, and regime-adjusted insights.
- Triggers on a variety of analytic and valuation-related user intents.
